module ahb_assertions ports HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HADDR:32 HTRANS:2 HWRITE:1 HSIZE:3 HBURST:3 HSEL:1 HWDATA:32 HRDATA:32 HREADY:1 HRESP:2
assert AHB_R01_SEQ_AFTER_NONSEQ in ahb_assertions, line 27
  clock     @(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn)
  expr      HTRANS == SEQ |-> $past(HTRANS) == NONSEQ || $past(HTRANS) == SEQ
  s1        HTRANS == SEQ
  s2        $past(HTRANS) == NONSEQ || $past(HTRANS) == SEQ
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HTRANS:2
  message   error "VIOLATION R01: SEQ without prior NONSEQ/SEQ"
assert AHB_R02_HTRANS_STABLE_WAIT in ahb_assertions, line 34
  clock     @(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn)
  expr      !HREADY |=> $stable(HTRANS)
  s1        !HREADY
  s2        $stable(HTRANS)
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HREADY:1 HTRANS:2
  message   error "VIOLATION R02: HTRANS changed during wait state"
assert AHB_R03_HADDR_STABLE_WAIT in ahb_assertions, line 40
  clock     @(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn)
  expr      !HREADY |=> $stable(HADDR)
  s1        !HREADY
  s2        $stable(HADDR)
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HREADY:1 HADDR:32
  message   error "VIOLATION R03: HADDR changed during wait state"
assert AHB_R04_HWDATA_STABLE_WAIT in ahb_assertions, line 46
  clock     @(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn)
  expr      HWRITE && !HREADY |=> $stable(HWDATA)
  s1        HWRITE && !HREADY
  s2        $stable(HWDATA)
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HWRITE:1 HREADY:1 HWDATA:32
  message   error "VIOLATION R04: HWDATA changed during wait state"
assert AHB_R05_HWRITE_STABLE_BURST in ahb_assertions, line 52
  clock     @(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn)
  expr      HTRANS == SEQ |-> $stable(HWRITE)
  s1        HTRANS == SEQ
  s2        $stable(HWRITE)
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HTRANS:2 HWRITE:1
  message   error "VIOLATION R05: HWRITE changed during burst"
assert AHB_R06_HSIZE_STABLE_BURST in ahb_assertions, line 58
  clock     @(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn)
  expr      HTRANS == SEQ |-> $stable(HSIZE)
  s1        HTRANS == SEQ
  s2        $stable(HSIZE)
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HTRANS:2 HSIZE:3
  message   error "VIOLATION R06: HSIZE changed during burst"
assert AHB_R07_RESET_IDLE in ahb_assertions, line 64
  clock     @(posedge HCLK)
  expr      !HRESETn |-> HTRANS == IDLE
  s1        !HRESETn
  s2        HTRANS == IDLE
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HTRANS:2
  message   error "VIOLATION R07: HTRANS not IDLE during reset"
assert AHB_R08_HSEL_ACTIVE in ahb_assertions, line 70
  clock     @(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn)
  expr      HTRANS == NONSEQ || HTRANS == SEQ |-> HSEL
  s1        HTRANS == NONSEQ || HTRANS == SEQ
  s2        HSEL
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HTRANS:2 HSEL:1
  message   error "VIOLATION R08: HSEL=0 during active transfer"
assert AHB_R09_ADDR_INCREMENT in ahb_assertions, line 76
  clock     @(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn)
  expr      HTRANS == SEQ && HREADY && HBURST == 3'b011 |-> HADDR == $past(HADDR) + 32'd4
  s1        HTRANS == SEQ && HREADY && HBURST == 3'b011
  s2        HADDR == $past(HADDR) + 32'd4
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HTRANS:2 HREADY:1 HBURST:3 HADDR:32
  message   error "VIOLATION R09: HADDR not incrementing in INCR4 burst"
assert AHB_R10_NO_SEQ_IN_IDLE in ahb_assertions, line 83
  clock     @(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn)
  expr      HTRANS == IDLE |=> HTRANS != SEQ
  s1        HTRANS == IDLE
  s2        HTRANS != SEQ
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HTRANS:2
  message   error "VIOLATION R10: SEQ follows IDLE"
assert AHB_R11_HRESP_ERROR_2CYC in ahb_assertions, line 89
  clock     @(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn)
  expr      HRESP == 2'b01 && !HREADY |=> HRESP == 2'b01
  s1        HRESP == 2'b01 && !HREADY
  s2        HRESP == 2'b01
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HRESP:2 HREADY:1
  message   error "VIOLATION R11: HRESP ERROR not held 2 cycles"
assert AHB_R12_HBURST_STABLE in ahb_assertions, line 95
  clock     @(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn)
  expr      HTRANS == SEQ |-> $stable(HBURST)
  s1        HTRANS == SEQ
  s2        $stable(HBURST)
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESETn:1 HTRANS:2 HBURST:3
  message   error "VIOLATION R12: HBURST changed during burst"
cover AHB_COV_NONSEQ in ahb_assertions, line 101
  clock     @(posedge HCLK)
  expr      HTRANS == NONSEQ
  s1        HTRANS == NONSEQ
  signals   HCLK:1 HTRANS:2
cover AHB_COV_SEQ in ahb_assertions, line 106
  clock     @(posedge HCLK)
  expr      HTRANS == SEQ
  s1        HTRANS == SEQ
  signals   HCLK:1 HTRANS:2
cover AHB_COV_WAIT in ahb_assertions, line 111
  clock     @(posedge HCLK)
  expr      !HREADY
  s1        !HREADY
  signals   HCLK:1 HREADY:1
cover AHB_COV_ERROR in ahb_assertions, line 116
  clock     @(posedge HCLK)
  expr      HRESP == 2'b01
  s1        HRESP == 2'b01
  signals   HCLK:1 HRESP:2
